# [TASK] Replace Jest with Vitest and update test configuration

## Task
CRA's Jest setup is incompatible with Vite. Replace with Vitest: install `vitest` + `@vitest/coverage-v8` + `jsdom`, update `vite.config.js` with a `test` block, update `package.json` test script, confirm all existing tests pass under Vitest.

## Parent Story
Parent: #122

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `npm test` runs Vitest (not Jest) and all existing tests pass. — `"test": "vitest run"`; 166/166 tests pass across 27 files.
- [x] `npm test -- --coverage` reports coverage meeting the 80% threshold. — 94.9% stmts / 84.42% branches / 88.05% funcs / 95.45% lines (v8 provider, thresholds enforced in `vite.config.js`).
- [x] `@testing-library/react` still works (it is Vitest-compatible). — confirmed across every component test file.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
Converted every `jest.*` call to `vi.*` (including two `jest.requireActual` factories to Vitest's async `importOriginal`), fixed a jsdom+JSS `CSS.escape` incompatibility, renamed one JSX-in-`.js` test file to `.jsx`, and fixed two AudioContext mocks that needed a `function` rather than an arrow implementation to stay constructable.

Once the suite actually ran again it was 2 points under the 80% branches threshold, from real pre-existing gaps in `services/media.js` and `AdminDashboard.jsx`. Closed with real tests rather than by lowering the threshold.

Out of scope, tracked as #131: `frontend-ci.yml` still passes `--watchAll=false`, which Vitest's CLI rejects outright.
